title: Outlook mobile: Purview DLP policy tips for iOS and Android (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
notes: claim 65: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the Purview policy creation path omits the Exchange email location choice, and the Cloud Policy control links to a page that does not document the named setting. The default policy tip text is also confused with email notification text; the roadmap facts and disabled-by-default mobile setting are supported.
